notes.title: The Junkyard: Patch 1.1.2 Details
notes.content:
[p]This patch is a mix of optimization and visual enhancements, adding post-processing and a new type of lighting that is more optimized and realistic.

[b]Update details:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Optimization and Lighting:[/b][/p][p]If the player moves far enough away to no longer see them, objects disappear;[/p][p]New lighting system, more realistic and optimized, and also fixes some lighting-related bugs;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Post-Processing:[/b][/p][p]Addition of Post-Processing, with different post-processing profiles for each scenario and a specific profile for Night Vision;[/p][p]Due to the addition of Post-Processing, some materials and some lights have been changed;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Settings:[/b][/p][p]Addition of the option to turn post-processing on/off;[/p][p]Minimum FPS limit reduced from 60 FPS to 30 FPS;[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Junkyard - Arsenal Update
notes.content:
[p][b]Below are all the details of the update:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Bug Fix:[/b][/p][p]Weapons no longer pass through walls.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Animations:[/b][/p][p]All weapon animations have been improved;[/p][p]A specific animation has been added when aiming;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shotgun:[/b][/p][p]After firing, the shotgun must be pumped;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reloading:[/b][/p][p]Weapons must be loaded with the \[R] key in order to use them; [/p][p]The shotgun has a unique way of reloading;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound Effects:[/b][/p][p]Each weapon has unique sound effects;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Realistic Movement and Visual Effects: [/b][/p][p]Procedural animations have been added to weapons that react to your movement; [/p][p]Improved visual effects when shooting; [/p][p]More realistic weapon recoil when shooting; [/p][p]Weapons have different weights; [/p][p]When aiming, weapon effects such as recoil are weaker;[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Weapon Available:[/b] [/p][p]AK-47 is available in Shelter 1;

[/p][previewyoutube="7ZJmiHvryNA;full"][/previewyoutube][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dead Effects Update
notes.content: [p]Update 1.1.0.2 is called ‘Dead Effects’, referring to the new special effects when eliminating or shooting an enemy. In addition, the update brings improvements to some materials and other existing effects.[/p][p][b]Here are all the details:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Blood Effects (Addition):[/b][/p][p]Blood Explosion (Small and Large);[/p][p]Splash (Small and Large) added to all enemies varying by size;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Taking Damage Animations (Addition):[/b][/p][p]Junkrat and Bagface react to taking damage;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Death Animations:[/b][/p][p]Bagface (Added Ragdoll when eliminated);[/p][p]Pawn (Animation Improvement);[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Camera shakes when taking damage (Addition):[/b][/p][p]When the player takes damage, the camera shakes with the same magnitude as the damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Problem when moving with low FPS (Bug fixed);[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Chess Battle Update:[/b][/p][p]New power added to the second boss phase: Blood Rain;[/p][p]Gold Rain (Improved effect using 3D drops);[/p][p]Authority Effect (Improved Final Explosion);[/p][p]Change in the transition from the first to the second phase;[/p][/*][*][p][b]Update to Lucifer's Home:[/b][/p][p]Cloud Effect (Improvement);[/p][p]Final Explosion (Improvement);[/p][/*][*][p][b]Materials upgrade:[/b][/p][p]Skins and Eyes[/p][/*][*][p][b]Added Impact Effect:[/b][/p][p]Effect added when shooting at any surface.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p]

notes.title: Help System Update - Details
notes.content:
Version 1.1.0.1 of The Junkyard arrives under the name ‘Help System Update’. This update adds a help system with a quick and simple tutorial to demonstrate the controls and mechanics of The Junkyard.

We've opted to keep the tutorial in both new and old Saves, as this allows old and new players to understand all the main mechanics and get the most out of The Junkyard.

notes.title: Light & Power Update
notes.content:
The Light & Power Update, version 1.1.0.0 of The Junkyard, brings significant changes to gameplay in the rusty tunnels.

The entire game has been adapted to support torch systems (equipment), with two types: the head torch and the night vision goggles. These adaptations range from changes to the inventory to the save system.

The torch brings an extra immersion to the rusty tunnels. It's now possible to get completely lost in the dark, so be careful and manage your batteries well. To toggle the torch use [F] and to toggle night vision use [N].

Batteries are used to power equipment and have a limited lifespan, which, when they run out, renders them useless. To change a device's battery, simply click on the device to view or change its battery.

In addition, it is now necessary to convert old Saves to the new version, causing some data to be lost.

With this new update, several doors have been opened for future features that are yet to come and The Junkyard is becoming more and more immersive.
